name: bigquery
description: Google BigQuery data warehouse. Optimized batch SOURCE (keyset-paginated reads that resume large tables to EOF) and DESTINATION (flag-gated bulk NDJSON load jobs with streaming fallback). Hand-curated; delegates to the shared BigQueryWarehouseAdapter.

supported_auth_methods.description: GCP service-account JSON key. If omitted, Application Default Credentials (ADC) / GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS are used.

project_id.description: GCP project that owns the dataset (billing + default query project).

dataset_id.description: Default BigQuery dataset for unqualified table names.

service_account_json.description: Full service-account JSON key. Leave empty to use ADC.

credentials_path.description: Path to a service-account JSON file (alternative to service_account_json).

operations.name: test_connection
operations.description: Run SELECT 1 to validate credentials + reachability.

operations.name: import_data
operations.description: Bulk-first append (load job when RSYNC_BQ_LOAD_JOB set) with streaming fallback.

operations.name: load
operations.description: Explicit bulk NDJSON load job (flag-gated) with streaming fallback.

operations.name: merge
operations.description: CDC-style MERGE upsert/delete (present but dormant in v1.0.0).
